title: SEC2: batch read receipts in handle_state_change instead of per-message HTTP calls
description: In handle_state_change(), when multiple inbound messages arrive in one SSE event, the code calls send_read_receipts() once per message in the for-loop body. This causes N separate JMAP HTTP calls instead of one batched call. Fix: collect all inbound IDs after the loop, then call send_read_receipts once with all IDs.
